spec.title: Mirror Requests by Result
spec.description: Content requests containerd sent to the mirror, by result: local, peer, stream (from a peer still receiving it in a spread), miss (went to the registry), error.

spec.expr: sum by (result) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Node Status
spec.description: One row per node, worst first: uptime (amber in its first hour); images that can't be pulled (stuck) or can't start (broken) there now; disk cleanup state; mirror hits, bytes from and to peers in the time range; memory really held (rss_anon); containerd calls per minute. Click a node to focus on it.

spec.expr: time() - max by (node, version) (angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"})
sum by (node) (angryduck_controller_rescue_stuck_images{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
count by (node) (angryduck_worker_broken_image{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})

max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
+ (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_stalled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) * 0)

sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~"local|peer|stream"}[$__range]))
/
(sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (node) (label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source=~"peer|stream"}[$__range]), "via", "mirror", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__range]), "via", "spread", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__range]), "via", "rescue", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__range]), "via", "repair", "", ""))

sum by (node) (label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_peer_served_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range]), "via", "mirror", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="served"}[$__range]), "via", "spread", "", "") or label_replace(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="served"}[$__range]), "via", "rescue", "", ""))
sum by (node) (rate(angryduck_worker_containerd_calls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

spec.title: Mirror Hit Ratio per Node (last hour)
spec.description: Per node, the share of containerd's content requests over the preceding hour that the mirror answered from the node itself or a peer instead of the registry. A sliding one-hour window, so a handful of requests doesn't swing it between 0 and 100%. No line: no requests that hour.

spec.expr:
sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result=~"local|peer|stream"}[1h]))
/ (sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h])) > 0)

defaults.noValue: No mirror requests in this time range

spec.title: Mirror Bytes by Source
spec.description: Bytes per second the mirror served, from this node or a peer.

spec.expr: sum by (source) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Bytes Served to Peers per Node
spec.description: Bytes per second each node served to other nodes: mirror, spreads and rescues together.

spec.expr: sum by (node) (label_replace(rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_peer_served_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]), "via", "mirror", "", "") or label_replace(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="served"}[$__rate_interval]), "via", "spread", "", "") or label_replace(rate(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="served"}[$__rate_interval]), "via", "rescue", "", "")) > 0

spec.title: Mirror Requests by Kind
spec.description: Mirror requests per kind (blob, manifest) and result.

spec.expr:
(
sum by (kind, result) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
)
and on () (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_requests_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

spec.title: Images per Registry Answer
spec.description: Distinct images on fresh nodes, by their registry's answer at the last check.

spec.expr: sum by (status) (angryduck_controller_origin_images{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"})

spec.title: Origin Checks by Answer
spec.description: Manifest HEAD requests the controller sent to registries, per minute, by answer.

spec.expr: sum by (status) (rate(angryduck_controller_origin_checks_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

spec.title: Images Gone from Registry
spec.description: Images their registry no longer serves, by answer.

spec.expr:
count by (status) (angryduck_controller_origin_unavailable{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", image=~"$mirror_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"})
or
(count by (status) (last_over_time(angryduck_controller_origin_unavailable{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", image=~"$mirror_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"}[$__range] @ end())) * 0)

spec.title: Nodes Cleaning
spec.description: Nodes whose disk went above GC_HIGH and are removing unused images until GC_LOW.

spec.expr: sum(angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Nodes Stalled
spec.description: Nodes above GC_HIGH where removing images frees nothing: the disk is full of something else.

spec.expr: sum(angryduck_worker_gc_stalled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Removable Now
spec.description: Images the cleanup could remove right now, across tiers. Retention copies are not counted: they go only when they expire.

spec.expr: sum(angryduck_worker_gc_candidates{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Where Delivered Image Bytes Came From
spec.description: Bytes per second Angry Duck delivered to the nodes, by source. Dashed: all of it added up. from the registry: what the registry served for spreads and repairs. The peer lines stayed inside the cluster. Spreads send an image to every eligible node, including nodes that never run it, so this isn't what the registry would have served without Angry Duck. Registry pulls containerd makes on its own (seed pulls, mirror misses) aren't measured in bytes and aren't included.

spec.expr:
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source=~"peer|stream"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))

(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
sum(rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source=~"peer|stream"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Images Removed in Range
spec.description: Images the cleanup removed in the time range.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier!="error"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Removal Errors in Range
spec.description: Removals that failed in the time range.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier="error"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Images Coming Back
spec.description: Images that came back within an hour of the cleanup removing them: something still uses them, so each removal cost a re-pull.

spec.expr: count(angryduck_worker_gc_image_returns{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Cleanup Status
spec.description: Per node: cleanup state (idle; cleaning = disk above GC_HIGH, removing unused images until GC_LOW; stalled = removing images frees nothing). old / pressure = images removable right now per tier; retained = retention copies the node keeps (never removed before they expire); companions = companion images here no container uses right now (kept: removed only under disk pressure, after every other unused image). removed, errors and came back (re-pulled within an hour of removal) count the time range. Stalled nodes first.

spec.expr:
max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
+ (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_stalled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) * 0)
sum by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_candidates{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier="old"})
sum by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_candidates{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier="pressure"})
sum by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_retained_images{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
sum by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_candidates{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier="companion"})
round(sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier!="error"}[$__range])))
round(sum by (node) (increase(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier="error"}[$__range])))
count by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_image_returns{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"})

spec.title: Cleanup State over Time
spec.description: Each node's disk cleanup over the time range: idle, cleaning (disk above GC_HIGH, removing unused images until GC_LOW) or stalled (removing images frees nothing: the disk is full of something else).

spec.expr:
max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})
+ (max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_stalled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) or max by (node) (angryduck_worker_gc_cleaning{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}) * 0)

spec.title: Images Removed by Tier
spec.description: Images removed per minute, by tier: old (unused for a while), pressure (disk above GC_HIGH), retention (an expired retention copy: the one node keeping an image the cluster stopped running, for GC_RETENTION_TTL_S), error.

spec.expr: sum by (tier) (rate(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

spec.title: Removable Images by Tier
spec.description: Images the cleanup could remove right now, per tier. old: unused past the age limit; pressure: removable when the disk is above GC_HIGH; retention copies are not candidates: they go only when they expire. Log scale.

spec.expr: sum by (tier) (angryduck_worker_gc_candidates{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})

spec.title: Images Removed per Node
spec.description: Images removed per minute on each node.

spec.expr: sum by (node) (rate(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier!="error"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

spec.title: Images Coming Back After Removal
spec.description: Images that came back within an hour of the cleanup removing them, and how many times.

spec.expr: max by (node, image) (angryduck_worker_gc_image_returns{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"})

defaults.noValue: No image came back within an hour of its removal

spec.title: Images Removed
spec.description: Images the cleanup removed, from which node, when and by which tier: old (unused for GC_UNUSED_FOR_S), pressure (disk above GC_HIGH), retention (an expired retention copy: the one node keeping an image the cluster stopped running, for GC_RETENTION_TTL_S).

spec.expr: max by (node, image, tier) (last_over_time(angryduck_worker_gc_image_removed_timestamp_seconds{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"}[$__range])) * 1000

defaults.noValue: The cleanup removed nothing in this time range

spec.title: Image Bytes Delivered, All vs From the Registry
spec.description: Bytes Angry Duck delivered to the nodes, added up since the start of the time range. Dashed: all of them, from peers and the registry. Solid: the part the registry served. Spreads send an image to every eligible node, including nodes that never run it, so this isn't what the registry would have served without Angry Duck. Registry pulls containerd makes on its own (seed pulls, mirror misses) aren't measured in bytes and aren't included.

spec.expr:
(
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source=~"peer|stream"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
) * $__interval_ms / 1000

(
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
) * $__interval_ms / 1000

spec.title: Images Coming Up for Removal
spec.description: Unused images the cleanup will remove, from which node and in how long: old and pressure by the age rule (disk pressure removes them sooner, oldest first), retention when a retention copy expires.

spec.expr: min by (node, image, tier) (angryduck_worker_gc_image_removal_seconds{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"})

defaults.noValue: No unused image is due for removal

spec.title: Workers (of ${workers_expected})
spec.description: Worker processes reporting.

spec.expr: count(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}) or vector(0)

max(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", daemonset=~".*angryduck-worker"})
and on () (count(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker"}) == count(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))
or on () count(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"})

spec.title: Controllers
spec.description: Controller processes reporting. Angry Duck runs one.

spec.expr: count(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Versions Running
spec.description: Distinct Angry Duck versions running. More than one: a rollout is in progress.

spec.expr: count(count by (version) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Restarts in Range
spec.description: Processes that started again within the time range.

spec.expr:
round((sum(changes(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
+ (sum(changes(angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

spec.title: Busiest Worker Memory
spec.description: Memory the hungriest worker really holds (rss_anon).

spec.title: containerd Calls / min
spec.description: gRPC calls all selected workers make to containerd.

spec.expr: sum(rate(angryduck_worker_containerd_calls_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or vector(0)

spec.title: Process Status
spec.description: One row per Angry Duck process: version, uptime, memory really held (rss_anon), live Go heap, and CPU as a share of one core (from cAdvisor).

spec.expr: time() - max by (pod, component, node, version) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))
max by (pod) (angryduck_process_memory_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", kind="rss_anon"})
max by (pod) (angryduck_process_memory_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", kind="heap_live"})

sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"}[$__rate_interval]))
and on (pod) group by (pod) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))

spec.title: Memory Held per Process
spec.description: Memory each process really holds (rss_anon): the number to size limits against. Container working set also counts the process's own code, which the kernel can drop.

spec.title: CPU per Process (share of one core)
spec.description: CPU cores each process uses (from cAdvisor).

spec.expr:
sum by (component, node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"}[$__rate_interval])
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (component, node)
  group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, component, node) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"})))

spec.title: Copies Kept
spec.description: Images the cluster stopped running, each kept on one node for GC_RETENTION_TTL_S after it went unused, so a rollback finds it on a peer instead of the registry.

spec.expr: sum(angryduck_controller_retention_copies{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", state="held"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Copies Waiting
spec.description: Images that went unused but have no node keeping them yet: no node below GC_RETENTION_MAX_UTILIZATION holds them, or they are being copied to one that has room.

spec.expr: sum(angryduck_controller_retention_copies{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", state=~"pending|copying"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Retention Paused
spec.description: Yes while every node is at or above GC_RETENTION_MAX_UTILIZATION: no copy is kept until a node has room again; the images that went unused meanwhile then get theirs, within their GC_RETENTION_TTL_S.

spec.expr: max(angryduck_controller_retention_paused{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Kept in Range
spec.description: Times a node was picked to keep an image's retention copy in the time range.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(angryduck_controller_retention_events_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", event="kept"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Used Again in Range
spec.description: Images that ran again while their retention copy was kept, in the time range: rollbacks (or jobs) that found the image on a node.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(angryduck_controller_retention_events_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", event="used"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Copies Lost in Range
spec.description: Retention copies whose node went away or no longer had the image (removed by hand, kubelet's image GC), in the time range. Another node is picked each time.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(angryduck_controller_retention_events_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", event="lost"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Retention Copies
spec.description: Every image the cluster stopped running, the one node keeping it, and when its copy expires (it is then removed at once). The cleanup leaves these alone until then, disk pressure included. A rollback in the meantime pulls through the mirror from that node.

spec.expr: min by (node, image) (angryduck_worker_gc_image_removal_seconds{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier="retention", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"})

spec.title: Retention Events
spec.description: Retention events per minute: went unused (nothing in the cluster runs the image anymore: a copy is due), kept (a node keeps it), copied (first copied to a node with room), used again (it runs again: no copy needed), lost (its node went away or dropped it), gone (no node holds it anymore), expired.

spec.expr: sum by (event) (rate(angryduck_controller_retention_events_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

spec.title: Retention History
spec.description: What happened to each image's retention copy, when, and on which node: went unused (nothing in the cluster runs it anymore; no node), kept, copied (to a node with room first), used again, lost (its node went away or dropped it), gone (no node holds it anymore; no node), expired.

spec.expr: max by (node, image, event) (last_over_time(angryduck_controller_image_retention_timestamp_seconds{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node|", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"}[$__range])) * 1000

defaults.noValue: No retention event in this time range

spec.title: Kept for Rollbacks
spec.description: The image's retention copy: when it went unused in the cluster, which node kept it, and when it was used again, lost, gone or expired. Hidden when nothing happened to its copy in the range.

spec.expr: max by (node, image, event) (last_over_time(angryduck_controller_image_retention_timestamp_seconds{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node|", image=~"$image", image=~"($registry)/.*"}[$__range])) * 1000

spec.title: Time Spent Pulling
spec.description: Time kubelet spent pulling images in the time range, added up over the selected nodes: pod-side waiting that a preheat or spread could have saved. From kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds.

spec.expr: sum(increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pod Start Spent Pulling
spec.description: Kubelet's image pull time as a share of pod start time (kubelet first sees the pod → running), both added up over the time range. Most pod starts pull nothing (the image is already there), so this shows how much of the cluster's total start time went to pulls. Pulls for restarted containers count too, so it's capped at 100%.

spec.expr: clamp_max(sum(increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) / (sum(increase(kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) > 0), 1)

spec.title: Kubelet Pull p95
spec.description: 95th percentile of the image pulls kubelet itself made in the time range (the ones Angry Duck didn't save it), mirror hits included. From kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Kept off the Registry
spec.description: Share of the image bytes Angry Duck delivered in the time range that came from a node instead of the registry: spreads, mirror, rescues and repairs together.

spec.expr:
((sum(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source=~"peer|stream"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))
/
(((sum(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source=~"peer|stream"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="peer"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="peer"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path="registry"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source="registry"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) > 0)

spec.title: Kubelet Pull Errors in Range
spec.description: Image pulls kubelet asked containerd for that failed in the time range. Rescue only acts on these after they happen; a steady count points at a registry or network problem rescue is hiding.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(kubelet_runtime_operations_errors_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", operation_type="pull_image"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Disk Pressure Time
spec.description: Node-time spent under kubelet's DiskPressure condition in the time range, summed over the selected nodes (kube-state-metrics). What the cleanup is there to keep at none.

spec.expr: (sum(sum_over_time((kube_node_status_condition{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", condition="DiskPressure", status="true"} == 1)[$__range:1m])) * 60) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pod Start vs Time Pulling (last hour)
spec.description: Over the preceding hour, per pod start: the average start (kubelet first sees the pod → running) and the image pull time kubelet spent per pod start. Most starts pull nothing, so the pull line is usually lower; when it climbs toward the start line, pulls are what pods wait on. No line: no pod started that hour.

spec.expr:
sum(rate(kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h]))
/ (sum(rate(kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h])) > 0)

sum(rate(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h]))
/ (sum(rate(kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h])) > 0)

spec.title: Containers Waiting on Images
spec.description: Containers waiting to start, by kubelet's reason (kube-state-metrics). ImagePullBackOff and ErrImagePull are pulls that failed (what rescue picks up); ContainerCreating is mostly a pull in progress. Short, rare bumps are a healthy rollout.

spec.expr:
sum by (reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", reason=~"ContainerCreating|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull"}
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}))
or
(sum by (reason) (last_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", reason=~"ContainerCreating|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull"}[$__range] @ end())) * 0)

spec.title: Image Delivery vs All Node Traffic In
spec.description: Bytes per second the selected nodes received on their network interfaces (node-exporter), next to the image bytes Angry Duck delivered to them from peers and the registry. Shows how much of the nodes' inbound traffic image delivery is, and whether its bursts line up with load.

spec.expr:
sum(max by (node) ((sum by (k8s_source_cluster, instance) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|vxlan.*|docker.*|tunl.*|tun.*|kube-.*|lxc.*|br-.*|virbr.*|cilium.*|genev.*|nodelocaldns.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, instance) group_left (node)
  label_replace(max by (k8s_source_cluster, instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)")))

(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", source=~"peer|stream"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_spread_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", path=~"peer|registry"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_rescue_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) +
(sum(rate(angryduck_worker_repair_bytes_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))

spec.title: containerd Disk Used per Node
spec.description: Used share of the disk containerd keeps images on (node-exporter): /var/lib/containerd when it has its own mount, / otherwise. Logs share this disk with images; the cleanup removes unused images when it climbs past GC_HIGH.

spec.expr:
max by (node) (((1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", mountpoint="/var/lib/containerd", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", mountpoint="/var/lib/containerd", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"})
or on (k8s_source_cluster, instance)
(1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"}))
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, instance) group_left (node)
  label_replace(max by (k8s_source_cluster, instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))

spec.title: Disk Pressure, Evictions & Kubelet Image GC
spec.description: What happens when disks fill anyway: nodes under DiskPressure (kube-state-metrics), pods evicted for disk, and images kubelet's own image GC removed (kubelet), next to Angry Duck's cleanup. With the cleanup working, the first three stay at zero. Hidden while none of them happened in the range.

spec.expr:
(sum(kube_node_status_condition{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", condition="DiskPressure", status="true"}) or vector(0))
and on () (
  max(max_over_time(kube_node_status_condition{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", condition="DiskPressure", status="true"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
  or sum(increase(kubelet_evictions{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", eviction_signal=~"nodefs.*|imagefs.*|containerfs.*"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
  or sum(increase(kubelet_image_garbage_collected_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
)

((sum(rate(kubelet_evictions{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", eviction_signal=~"nodefs.*|imagefs.*|containerfs.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60) or vector(0))
and on () (
  max(max_over_time(kube_node_status_condition{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", condition="DiskPressure", status="true"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
  or sum(increase(kubelet_evictions{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", eviction_signal=~"nodefs.*|imagefs.*|containerfs.*"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
  or sum(increase(kubelet_image_garbage_collected_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
)

((sum(rate(kubelet_image_garbage_collected_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60) or vector(0))
and on () (
  max(max_over_time(kube_node_status_condition{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", condition="DiskPressure", status="true"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
  or sum(increase(kubelet_evictions{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", eviction_signal=~"nodefs.*|imagefs.*|containerfs.*"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
  or sum(increase(kubelet_image_garbage_collected_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
)

((sum(rate(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier!="error"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60) or vector(0))
and on () (
  max(max_over_time(kube_node_status_condition{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", condition="DiskPressure", status="true"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
  or sum(increase(kubelet_evictions{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", eviction_signal=~"nodefs.*|imagefs.*|containerfs.*"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
  or sum(increase(kubelet_image_garbage_collected_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0
)

spec.title: CPU Throttling per Process
spec.description: Share of CPU periods in which an Angry Duck process hit its CPU limit (cAdvisor), for the processes throttled at least once in the range. Short spikes during spreads and pulls are expected; a steady share slows delivery down. Hidden while nothing was throttled.

spec.expr:
(max by (component, node) ((sum by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"}[$__rate_interval]))
/ (sum by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0))
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (component, node) group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, component, node) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))))
and on (component, node) (max_over_time((max by (component, node) ((sum by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"}[$__rate_interval]))
/ (sum by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0))
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (component, node) group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, component, node) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"}))))[$__range:1m] @ end()) > 0)

spec.title: Memory vs Limit per Process
spec.description: Each Angry Duck process's working set (cAdvisor) as a share of its memory limit (kube-state-metrics). Near 1 means the next spread or rescue could be OOM-killed; low everywhere means the limit can come down.

spec.expr:
max by (component, node) ((max by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller"})
/ (max by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"worker|controller", resource="memory"}) > 0))
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (component, node) group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, component, node) ((angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="controller"} or angryduck_build_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", component="worker", node=~"$node"})))

spec.title: Node Disk Busy
spec.description: Share of time each node's busiest disk was doing I/O (node-exporter). Spreads, pulls and unpacking write here; so do apps and logs. Spikes that line up with spreads are the delivery's cost on the node.

spec.expr:
max by (node) ((max by (k8s_source_cluster, instance) (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", device!~"loop.*|ram.*|sr.*|fd.*|nbd.*"}[$__rate_interval])))
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, instance) group_left (node)
  label_replace(max by (k8s_source_cluster, instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", nodename=~"$node"}), "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.+)"))

spec.title: Kubelet Pull Time Distribution
spec.description: Every image pull kubelet made, by how long it took (rows) and when (columns); the darker a cell, the more pulls landed in it. A healthy cluster shows a few cells low down; a band climbing up the chart is pulls getting slower. From kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds; pulls Angry Duck delivered ahead of time never reach kubelet and don't appear.

spec.expr: sum by (le) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__interval]))

defaults.noValue: No kubelet pulls in this time range

spec.title: Kubelet Pull Time Percentiles (last hour)
spec.description: How long kubelet's image pulls took over the preceding hour: half were faster than p50, nine in ten faster than p90, and p99 is the slow tail. Next to it, the average. A p99 far above p50 means a few pulls (a big image, a slow node, a mirror miss) dominate the wait. No line: no pull that hour.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (rate(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h])))

sum(rate(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h])) / (sum(rate(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[1h])) > 0)

spec.title: Kubelet Pulls by Image Size
spec.description: Image pulls kubelet made per minute, by image size class, next to the pulls that failed. Shows what the waiting is made of: many small pulls, or a few big ones.

spec.expr: (sum by (image_size_in_bytes) (rate(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60)
(sum(rate(kubelet_runtime_operations_errors_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", operation_type="pull_image"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pull Time by Image Size
spec.description: Per image size class, over the time range: how many pulls kubelet made, their average, median (p50), p95 and slowest bucket (p99). Bigger images take longer by nature; a small class with a high p95 is the one to look at. Percentiles are estimated inside kubelet's buckets (… 30 s, 1 min, 2 min …), so a p95 of 1.7 to 1.9 min only says "between 1 and 2 minutes".

spec.expr: round(sum by (image_size_in_bytes) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))

sum by (image_size_in_bytes) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) / (sum by (image_size_in_bytes) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) > 0)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, image_size_in_bytes) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, image_size_in_bytes) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, image_size_in_bytes) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))

defaults.noValue: No kubelet pulls in this time range

spec.title: Pull Time per Node
spec.description: Per node, over the time range: kubelet's image pulls, their average, p50 and p95, and pulls that failed. Slowest first: a node that tops this list for every size of image usually has a slow link or a busy disk. Click a node to focus. Percentiles are estimated inside kubelet's buckets (… 30 s, 1 min, 2 min …), so a p95 of 1.7 to 1.9 min only says "between 1 and 2 minutes".

spec.expr: round(sum by (node) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))

sum by (node) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_sum{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) / (sum by (node) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) > 0)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, node) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, node) (increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))
round(sum by (node) (increase(kubelet_runtime_operations_errors_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", operation_type="pull_image"}[$__range])))

defaults.noValue: No kubelet pulls in this time range

spec.title: New Image Versions
spec.description: Image references (repo:tag or digest) that containers started using in the time range and that no container used at its start: roughly how many rollouts happened. Every new version is a pull on each node that runs it, unless something put it there first. Cluster-wide, not filtered by node.

spec.expr:
count(
  count by (image_spec) (last_over_time(kube_pod_container_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range]))
  unless count by (image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"} offset $__range)
) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pod Starts
spec.description: Pods kubelet started in the time range on the selected nodes: rollouts, scale-outs, Jobs and rescheduling together. From kubelet's own count, so it includes pods too short-lived for kube-state-metrics to ever see. Each start runs on a node that may or may not have its images.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Kubelet Pulls
spec.description: Image pulls kubelet itself had to make in the time range, successful ones (kubelet). Each is a container that found its image missing on its node, or that asks the registry every time (imagePullPolicy: Always).

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pulls per Pod Start
spec.description: Kubelet pulls divided by pod starts in the time range. Near 0: pods nearly always find their images on the node. Rising: more starts wait on the registry (frequent new tags, images removed too eagerly, imagePullPolicy: Always). A pod with several containers can pull more than once, so this can pass 1.

spec.expr: sum(increase(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) / (sum(increase(kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: Pulls Saved by Angry Duck
spec.description: Node and image pairs where Angry Duck delivered the image (spread, seed, propagation, rescue) and a container then ran it on that node in the time range: pulls kubelet would otherwise have made itself. 0 on clusters without Angry Duck.

spec.expr:
count(count by (image, node) (last_over_time(angryduck_controller_image_delivery_seconds{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", image=~"($registry)/.*", via!~"kubelet|present"}[$__range]))
  and on (image, node)
count by (image, node) (
  label_replace(last_over_time(kube_pod_container_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range]), "image", "$1", "image_spec", "(.+)")
  * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, uid) group_left (node) group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod, uid, node) (last_over_time(kube_pod_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", node!=""}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Container Restarts
spec.description: Container restarts in the time range on the selected nodes (kube-state-metrics). A restart reuses the image already on the node, so it costs no pull unless imagePullPolicy is Always.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range]) * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (last_over_time(kube_pod_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", node!=""}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pod Starts, Pulls & Restarts per Minute
spec.description: Per minute: pods kubelet started, the pulls it had to make for them, pulls that failed, and container restarts. Pulls following starts closely means pods keep finding their images missing; a failed line that never drops is stuck pods retrying, not a rollout.

spec.expr: (sum(rate(kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60) or vector(0)
(sum(rate(kubelet_image_pull_duration_seconds_count{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60) or vector(0)
(sum(rate(kubelet_runtime_operations_errors_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", operation_type="pull_image"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60) or vector(0)

(sum(rate(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) group_left group by (k8s_source_cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"})) * 60) or vector(0)

spec.title: Busiest Workloads
spec.description: Workloads that created pods on the selected nodes in the time range, most first: pods created, image versions their containers used (more than one: a rollout happened), container restarts, and containers waiting on an image right now. The top rows are where pulls come from; a CronJob or a crash-looping app here explains a high pulls-per-start.

spec.expr:

spec.title: Tags Resolved by Registry Answer
spec.description: Tags containerd asked the mirror to resolve, by what the registry answered: ok (its digest was served, or containerd went to it when no node had that digest), missing, denied (Angry Duck's credentials), unreachable (no answer within MIRROR_RESOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS; then left alone for MIRROR_RESOLVE_UNREACHABLE_TTL_S), or unchecked (no node holds the tag, so nobody asked and containerd went to the registry). With any answer but ok, the newest copy a node holds was served.

spec.expr:
(
sum by (origin) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_resolves_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
)
and on () (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_resolves_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

spec.title: Where Resolved Manifests Came From
spec.description: Tags the mirror resolved, by where the manifest came from: local (this node), peer, or miss (no node holds that digest, or no node holds the tag: containerd went to the registry).

spec.expr:
(
sum by (result) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_resolves_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
)
and on () (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_resolves_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

spec.title: Rescue Attempts by Cause
spec.description: Rescues tried per minute, cluster-wide (the node filter doesn't apply), by why the pull failed, as kubelet reported it: missing on the registry, denied (the pod's pull secret was refused), registry unreachable, or other. Skips aren't counted here; see Rescues by Result.

spec.expr:
(
sum by (cause) (rate(angryduck_controller_rescues_by_cause_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", result=~"success|failure"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60
)
and on () (sum(increase(angryduck_controller_rescues_by_cause_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", result=~"success|failure"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

spec.title: Pulls the Mirror Kept from Getting Stuck
spec.description: Tags the registry couldn't resolve that the mirror served from this node or a peer instead, per minute, by the registry's answer. Each one is a pull that would otherwise have gone to ImagePullBackOff.

spec.expr:
(
sum by (origin) (rate(angryduck_worker_mirror_resolves_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", origin=~"missing|denied|unreachable", result=~"local|peer"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60
)
and on () (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_mirror_resolves_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", origin=~"missing|denied|unreachable", result=~"local|peer"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

spec.title: Layers Unpacked on Arrival by Result
spec.description: Per minute, layers a node unpacked as soon as the layer and the ones below it were there, before the image registered: unpacked on arrival, already unpacked (nothing to do), or left to finalize (the early unpack failed, so the image's own unpack does it at registration). Hidden when none happened.

spec.expr:
(
sum by (result) (rate(angryduck_worker_spread_unpacks_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60
)
and on () (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_unpacks_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

spec.title: Layers Unpacked on Arrival per Node
spec.description: Per minute, layers each node unpacked while the rest of the image was still arriving. This unpacking used to run all at once after the last layer landed; the more of it happens here, the sooner the image is ready. Hidden when none happened.

spec.expr:
(
sum by (node) (rate(angryduck_worker_spread_unpacks_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="applied"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60
)
and on () (sum(increase(angryduck_worker_spread_unpacks_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", result="applied"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

spec.title: Companions Kept
spec.description: Companion images: images a pod runs beside an app image (sidecars, exporters, proxies). Each is spread to every eligible node and kept there: never removed for age, and under disk pressure only after every other unused image.

spec.expr: sum(angryduck_controller_companion_images{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", state="kept"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Not Kept
spec.description: Companion images not kept: above COMPANION_MAX_MB, or no node reported their size yet. They follow the ordinary cleanup rules.

spec.expr: sum(angryduck_controller_companion_images{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", state=~"too_large|size_unknown"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Space They Take
spec.description: Bytes of the kept companion images together: what they take on a node that holds them all.

spec.expr: max(angryduck_controller_companion_bytes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Copies Still Missing
spec.description: Kept companion images not yet on an eligible node, summed over images. They arrive from peers once no push is spreading. Excluded and too-full nodes are not counted.

spec.expr: sum(angryduck_controller_companion_nodes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", state="missing"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Copied in Range
spec.description: Companion images copied to nodes from their peers in the time range.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(angryduck_controller_companion_transfers_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", result="success"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Removed Under Pressure
spec.description: Companion images removed in the time range because a disk stayed above GC_HIGH_UTILIZATION after every other unused image was gone. They come back once the node has room.

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier="companion"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Companion Images
spec.description: Every kept companion image: nodes that have it, eligible nodes still missing it, and nodes skipped (excluded from propagation, or above PROPAGATE_MAX_UTILIZATION). Images still missing somewhere first.

spec.expr: max by (image) (angryduck_controller_companion_nodes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", state="have", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"})
max by (image) (angryduck_controller_companion_nodes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", state="missing", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"})
max by (image) (angryduck_controller_companion_nodes{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", state="skipped", image=~"$cleanup_image", image=~"($registry)/.*"})

spec.title: Companion Copies & Removals
spec.description: Per minute: companion images copied to nodes from peers (copied), copies that failed (failed, retried with backoff), and companions removed under disk pressure (removed).

spec.expr: sum by (result) (rate(angryduck_controller_companion_transfers_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60
sum (rate(angryduck_worker_gc_images_deleted_total{k8s_source_cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node", tier="companion"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60
